description: This file defines functions, types, and constants related to JSON parsing and manipulation, including functions to parse JSON strings, read JSON files, access JSON items and values, and manage JSON objects. It appears to be part of a testing/mocking framework given its location in a 'mocks' directory.

methods.name: SetJsonVars
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and optionally writes key-value pairs to an output file or sets environment variables.

methods.name: ParseJsonStr
methods.description: Parses a JSON string and returns a pointer to a JSON object.

methods.name: FreeJson
methods.description: Frees a JSON object created by ParseJsonStr to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: GetJsonItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific JSON item from a JSON object by name.

methods.name: GetJsonValFromString
methods.description: Extracts the value associated with a specified name from a JSON string.

methods.name: GetJsonVal
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a name from a JSON object.

methods.name: GetJsonValContainingFromString
methods.description: Searches a JSON string for a name containing a given substring and retrieves its value.

methods.name: GetJsonValContaining
methods.description: Searches within a JSON object (or string) for a name containing a given substring and retrieves its value.

methods.name: GetJson
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and returns its contents as a string.

methods.name: IsJsonArray
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object is an array.

methods.name: GetJsonArraySize
methods.description: Returns the number of items in a JSON array.

methods.name: GetJsonArrayItem
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specified index from a JSON array.
